metaDescription: Kevin reports Trump's disclosed Axon stake and an ICE stun gun notice, and notes Peter Thiel's Founders Fund backed Flock Safety.
summary: Kevin reports that Donald Trump's financial disclosures show a 1 to 5 million dollar investment in Axon Enterprises, bought in February, and that two weeks later ICE posted a notice for a multi-million dollar Axon stun gun contract. Kevin predicts Axon may buy Flock Safety and keep its camera infrastructure. He notes Peter Thiel's Founders Fund backed Flock and argues surveillance, transhumanism and the missing scientists may be parts of one unified thing. He declines to give stock advice, and says he sees the Axon-Flock connection as part of a broader pattern he attributes to transhumanist backers.
